title: Malicious code in @zread/cli-win32-arm64 (npm)
description: The npm package @zread/cli-win32-arm64 contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise includes potential exposure of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised computer is strongly advised. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by the package.
